disambiguation: Not merely a note organizer; it validates Markdown content against defined schemas.
extras: Warning: Schema rules are JSONata expressions and can run arbitrary code.
intentEvidence: This plugin brings inline validation to your structured markdown content — knowledge wikis, product/strategy frameworks
problem: Maintaining consistency and structural integrity across complex, schema-governed knowledge bases in Markdown is difficult without dedicated validation.
summary: A validation tool that checks Markdown notes against defined schemas, highlighting errors, warnings, and structural violations directly within the editor.
